question.question: 3-methylbutan-2-ol, CH3–CH(CH3)–CH(OH)–CH3, reacts with HBr. Identify the major product (P).

lesson.title: Br kahan lagega?
lesson.concept: Protonation, water loss, stabilising hydride shift aur nucleophilic capture.
lesson.scene_title: Original OH site ya rearranged carbon?
lesson.asked: Major product ka structure aur uske banne ka reason.
assumptions: The major substitution pathway under the question's HBr conditions is considered.
objectives: Initial OH-bearing carbon aur final electrophilic carbon alag pehchanna.
Electron-pair arrows se bonds aur charges track karna.
Hydride shift ko carbocation stability se justify karna.

prerequisites.why: Oxygen apna electron pair proton ko de sakta hai.
Positive carbon ke directly attached carbon neighbours stability compare karne mein madad karte hain.
Arrow electron pair ki movement dikhata hai, positive charge ki movement nahi.

evidence.idea: Alcohol classification depends on the carbon bearing OH.
Oxygen lone pairs allow alcohols to accept a proton.
Protonated alcohols undergo carbon–oxygen bond cleavage as electrophiles.
Nucleophiles can supply an electron pair to a carbocation.

lines: step protonate Oxygen accepts proton and bromide forms: lp 5 -> 6; bond 6-7 -> 7
step leave Water leaves and secondary carbocation forms: bond 2-5 -> 5
step rearrange Adjacent hydride shifts with its bond pair to form tertiary carbocation: shift 9 3 -> 2
step capture Bromide attacks the tertiary carbocation: lp 7 -> 3
trap direct after leave Capture before checking stabilising rearrangement: lp 7 -> 2

stages.title: Reactive jagah pehchano
stages.text: Starting OH site final Br site hona zaroori nahi.

beats.say: Yeh alcohol HBr se react karta hai; humein major product ka structure chunna hai.
beats.voice: यह ऐल्कोहॉल एचबीआर से रिऐक्ट करता है; हमें मेजर प्रॉडक्ट का स्ट्रक्चर चुनना है।

beats.say: Pehle OH wala carbon chuno, paas ka zyada branched carbon nahi.
beats.voice: पहले ओएच वाला कार्बन चुनो, पास का ज़्यादा ब्रांच्ड कार्बन नहीं।

stages.title: Seedha replacement kyun adhura hai?
stages.text: Original OH site par Br rakhna stability check ko skip karta hai.

beats.say: Sirf OH ki jagah Br rakhna aasaan lagta hai, isliye unrearranged product tempting hai.
beats.voice: सिर्फ़ ओएच की जगह बीआर रखना आसान लगता है, इसलिए अनरिअरेंज्ड प्रॉडक्ट टेम्प्टिंग है।

beats.say: Lekin yeh shortcut maanta hai ki reactive carbon badlega nahi; carbocation ki stability check karni padegi.
beats.voice: लेकिन यह शॉर्टकट मानता है कि रिऐक्टिव कार्बन बदलेगा नहीं; कार्बोकैटायन की स्टेबिलिटी चेक करनी पड़ेगी।

stages.title: Leaving group taiyaar karo
stages.text: Protonation ke baad OH neutral water ke roop mein nikal sakta hai.

beats.say: Oxygen ka lone pair proton ko pakad sakta hai; pehle donor aur acceptor jodo.
beats.voice: ऑक्सीजन का लोन पेयर प्रोटॉन को पकड़ सकता है; पहले डोनर और ऐक्सेप्टर जोड़ो।

beats.say: Oxygen proton leta hai aur HBr ke bond ka pair bromine ko milta hai.
beats.voice: ऑक्सीजन प्रोटॉन लेता है और एचबीआर के बॉन्ड का पेयर ब्रोमीन को मिलता है।

beats.say: Oxygen ab positive hai; carbon oxygen bond ka pair lekar woh neutral water banata hai.
beats.voice: ऑक्सीजन अब पॉज़िटिव है; कार्बन ऑक्सीजन बॉन्ड का पेयर लेकर वह न्यूट्रल वॉटर बनाता है।

stages.title: Charge track karke product banao
stages.text: Secondary carbocation se hydride shift tertiary carbocation deta hai, phir bromide capture hota hai.

beats.say: Positive carbon ke paas wale carbon par hydrogen dekho; kaunsi movement zyada stable carbocation degi?
beats.voice: पॉज़िटिव कार्बन के पास वाले कार्बन पर हाइड्रोजन देखो; कौनसी मूवमेंट ज़्यादा स्टेबल कार्बोकैटायन देगी?

beats.say: Hydrogen apne bond pair ke saath shift hota hai; purana positive carbon neutral hota hai.
beats.voice: हाइड्रोजन अपने बॉन्ड पेयर के साथ शिफ्ट होता है; पुराना पॉज़िटिव कार्बन न्यूट्रल होता है।

beats.say: Naye positive carbon ke teen carbon neighbours hain; bromide ka pair ab kahan jaayega?
beats.voice: नए पॉज़िटिव कार्बन के तीन कार्बन नेबर्स हैं; ब्रोमाइड का पेयर अब कहाँ जाएगा?

beats.say: Bromide naya bond banaakar charge neutral karta hai; product hai 2-bromo-2-methylbutane, yaani option do.
beats.voice: ब्रोमाइड नया बॉन्ड बनाकर चार्ज न्यूट्रल करता है; प्रॉडक्ट है टू-ब्रोमो-टू-मिथाइलब्यूटेन, यानी ऑप्शन दो।

stages.title: Halide badlo, reasoning lagao
stages.text: HBr ki jagah HCl ke saath analogous substitution product predict karo.

beats.say: Ab sirf HBr ki jagah HCl rakho; carbon skeleton aur alcohol wahi rehte hain.
beats.voice: अब सिर्फ़ एचबीआर की जगह एचसीएल रखो; कार्बन स्केलेटन और ऐल्कोहॉल वही रहते हैं।

beats.say: Khud stability check lagao aur batao, analogous substitution mein chloride kis carbon par lagega.
beats.voice: खुद स्टेबिलिटी चेक लगाओ और बताओ, अनैलॉगस सब्स्टिट्यूशन में क्लोराइड किस कार्बन पर लगेगा।

details.title: OH se water leaving group
details.text: Protonation oxygen par positive charge laati hai. C–O cleavage mein pair oxygen par jaane se neutral water aur carbocation bante hain.
chain: Alcohol oxygen ke paas lone pair hai.
Protonation ke baad C–O pair oxygen leta hai.
Neutral water nikalta hai; carbon positive hota hai.

details.title: Hydride shift ka fayda
details.text: Adjacent hydrogen apne C–H bond pair ke saath migrate karta hai. Donor carbon positive hota hai, jiske teen carbon neighbours charge ko stabilise karte hain.
chain: Initial positive carbon ke do carbon neighbours hain.
Adjacent C–H bond pair hydrogen ke saath migrate karta hai.
Naye positive carbon ke teen carbon neighbours hain.

gates.prompt: Starting alcohol mein OH kis carbon se attached hai?

wrong.why: Zyada branched carbon starting OH-bearing carbon nahi hai.
Oxygen ka directly bonded carbon pehchanna hai, koi bhi chain carbon nahi.

gates.why: OH seedhe C2 se juda hai; is carbon ke do carbon neighbours hain, isliye starting alcohol secondary hai.

gates.prompt: Protonation ke liye electron-pair donor ko proton se jodo.

wrong.why: Proton electron pair nahi deta; oxygen apna lone pair deta hai.
Alcohol oxygen proton accept karta hai, carbon skeleton nahi.

gates.why: Oxygen–hydrogen bond banta hai aur H–Br bond ka pair bromine par jaata hai.

gates.prompt: Water loss ke baad major pathway ka agla useful event kya hai?
choices: Adjacent hydride ka positive carbon par shift
Bromide ko turant original site par fix karna
Hydrogen ko electron pair ke bina shift karna

wrong.why: Yeh stabilising rearrangement skip karke unrearranged structure ko major maan leta hai.
Hydride migration mein C–H bond pair bhi move karta hai; proton akela nahi.

gates.why: Hydride shift secondary carbocation ko zyada stable tertiary carbocation mein badalta hai.

gates.prompt: Rearrangement ke baad bromide kis carbon par attack karega?

wrong.why: Original OH carbon ab neutral hai; positive charge adjacent carbon par aa chuka hai.
Nucleophile positive, electron-deficient carbon ko electron pair deta hai.

gates.why: Bromide tertiary carbocation se bond banaakar neutral alkyl bromide deta hai.

gates.prompt: HCl ke saath analogous substitution mein chloride kahan lagega?

wrong.why: Halide badalne se stabilising hydride shift ka structural reason khatam nahi hota.

gates.why: Carbocation stability final attachment site guide karti hai; halide ab chloride hai.

board.note: Oxygen proton accept karta hai; oxonium aur bromide bante hain.
C–O pair oxygen leta hai; neutral water aur secondary carbocation milte hain.
Adjacent hydride bond pair ke saath migrate karke tertiary carbocation deta hai.
Bromide ka lone pair C–Br bond banata hai: 2-bromo-2-methylbutane, option 2.

diagnoses.title: Galat skeleton
diagnoses.why: Yeh neopentyl connectivity hai; actual hydride shift carbon–carbon skeleton nahi badalta.

diagnoses.title: Stability-guided capture
diagnoses.why: Water loss ke baad hydride shift tertiary carbocation deta hai, jise bromide capture karta hai.

diagnoses.title: Carbon conservation chhoota
diagnoses.why: Is alkene mein starting alcohol se ek carbon kam hai; simple substitution ya dehydration mein carbon gaayab nahi hota.

diagnoses.title: Rearrangement skip hua
diagnoses.why: Original secondary carbocation par direct capture ka structure hai; stabilising hydride shift miss hota hai.

families.title: Migrating group pehchano
families.question: Water loss ke baad major rearrangement kaunsi movement se hota hai?
choices: OH ka neutral carbon par migration
families.why: Adjacent C–H pair positive carbon se bond banata hai aur tertiary carbocation milta hai.

families.title: Halide identity badli
families.question: Isi alcohol ki HCl se analogous substitution mein rearranged product kaunsa hai?
changes: step protonate Oxygen accepts proton and chloride forms: lp 5 -> 6; bond 6-7 -> 7
step capture Chloride attacks the tertiary carbocation: lp 7 -> 3
families.why: Halide badla hai, lekin stabilising hydride shift ke baad electrophilic carbon wahi hai.

lesson.recap: Protonation, water loss, stability check, hydride shift, phir bromide capture: major product 2-bromo-2-methylbutane, option 2.
limitations: Provided text supports proton acceptance, protonated-alcohol C–O cleavage and nucleophilic capture, but does not explicitly describe this substrate's hydride rearrangement.
The model represents the major substitution pathway, not quantitative competition with elimination or unrearranged capture.
Atom-tracking tags remain fixed; final IUPAC numbering is assigned independently.
The HCl transfer tests analogous substitution connectivity, not equal rates or yields.
